patterns: Mostly direct one-liners: which is a cash crop / kharif crop / not a cash crop; size class of marginal or small holding.
Trap options mix a food crop (jowar, soybean, gram) into a cash-crop list; kharif lists hinge on mustard/wheat/gram being rabi.
AP tilt is numeric: NSA % of geographical area, foodgrain area in a given year (lakh ha) - options differ by ~3 lakh ha.
Agro-climatic zone count questions (6/7/9) have changing keys; answer per latest AP Socio-Economic Survey.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement items with Economic Survey 2025-26 figures, heavier than the PYQs' simple fact recall.
